items.title: Mrs. Cozzy Cary Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: INTERVIEWER: His name is Ed. ... [INTERVIEWEE] He was kind of a little odd, you know? ... He was right there. He was up on there playing his music on the team.

ctx.x: We'd be like, you know what to sing on that comb. Good. Yeah.

And he'd say, come on. Let's have church. I'd say, okay. What you want to sing? He said, sing what you're singing. Well, I just go on and sing. He catch it just like you start the music. The two raps and then he just go on and off. His name is Ed. Do you remember his last name? He lives on Monroe and Algae? No, no. He used to get up one of his feet here. Oh, here. But I don't know. He was kind of a little odd, you know? Well, I'll find that from somebody. He was right there. He was up on there playing his music…
Did he have a flight in church?
